notes: It no longer says it is sending pictures it has not got: the product list it was given claimed photos were attached whenever anything matched, so it said 'here are the photos' and nothing went out. It is now told what is actually attached and stopped if it says otherwise. It also cannot promise an invoice or a price cut on your behalf unless a person was really alerted. Mixed orders are read a sentence at a time, so ten of one thing is no longer priced as ten of another.
